90% of women experiencing peri/menopause symptoms say it affects their work, leading to decreased productivity, increased absenteeism, and in some cases, talent loss.
Adora provides clinically-led comprehensive support to help your employees navigate the challenges of this life stage.

By offering Adora as part of your benefits and wellbeing strategy you can reduce the impact of menopause on retention and productivity, improve gender equity and hiring success, and support senior experienced workers through this life stage.
